rows.name: [XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]Riki, why did you become a hero?[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT3 ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT7 ]He chose you? So you weren't[XENO:n ]
chosen from birth?[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:act act=EVT2 ]No-mo. It was Donga's intuition-mo.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]Why are you surprised-mo? His[XENO:n ]
intuition is right, so he's a prophet-mo.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT3 ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT7 ]I see. Maybe that's how heroes and[XENO:n ]
champions come to be.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT9 ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:act act=EVT4 ]But he is kind of...compact...for a warrior hero.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT10 ]Riki owes the village a lot of money-mo.[XENO:wait wait=key ]

But the village promised to clear Riki's debt[XENO:n ]
if Riki defeats the great dinosaur-mo.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT12 ]
[XENO:act act=EVT1 ]So Riki doesn't mind being chosen as the hero-mo.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
